articleTitle: How to Plan for Aging Without Kids (and With a Disabled Dependent)
imageHeadline: Planning for aging when you're the caregiver—not the cared-for
imageSubtext: Building a support plan without relying on family
pinTitle: How to Plan for Aging Without Kids (Especially When You're a Caregiver)
pinDescription: If you're caring for a disabled dependent and wondering who will help you both decades from now, you're not alone. This guide walks through practical steps to build a long-term support plan—financial, legal, and social—when traditional family networks aren't the answer.
